articles.title: OpenAI brings Work features to ChatGPT
articles.summary: OpenAI is rolling out ChatGPT Work capabilities directly into regular Chat while combining usage allowances across ChatGPT and Codex. The changes are intended to simplify access to more advanced workflows and give subscribers greater flexibility in how they use OpenAI's products.

articles.title: Over 1,000 GitLab servers exposed to active attacks
articles.summary: More than 1,000 internet-facing GitLab servers remain vulnerable to a maximum-severity remote code execution flaw that attackers are actively exploiting. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-97229, affects GitLab's CI/CD Regular Expression Compiler and can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. CISA has added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

articles.title: WorkOS discloses AI-assisted data security incident
articles.summary: WorkOS disclosed unauthorized access to an internal sales application on October 30, exposing business contact information, customer account histories, and excerpts from customer communications. The company identified the use of an AI-assisted offensive security framework to automate reconnaissance and exploitation attempts. It has disabled external access to the affected application while it investigates the full impact.

articles.title: Connecting Gemini Enterprise to Snowflake data
articles.summary: Google Cloud published a guide demonstrating how to connect Gemini Enterprise agents to Snowflake using the Model Context Protocol and Agent Development Kit. The architecture enables agents to translate natural-language requests into SQL queries through Snowflake Cortex while enforcing user-level permissions and existing data governance controls.

articles.title: Are AI certifications still worth it in 2026?
articles.summary: The AI certification landscape has shifted as cloud vendors retire older credentials and introduce exams focused on generative AI and agents. Meanwhile, employers are becoming increasingly skeptical of certifications alone, pushing IT professionals to demonstrate practical skills alongside formal credentials.

articles.title: CrowdStrike and Dell team up to secure enterprise AI
articles.summary: CrowdStrike and Dell Technologies announced an integrated security solution for the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, combining AI infrastructure with protection for workloads, agents, and applications. Customers will be able to purchase Dell's AI infrastructure alongside CrowdStrike's Falcon security platform through Dell's AI Ecosystem Program.

articles.title: Microsoft and Lumen expand partnership for AI-ready networks
articles.summary: Microsoft and Lumen are expanding their collaboration to help enterprises connect data, applications, and infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. The companies plan to jointly sell networking solutions and explore bringing additional Lumen capabilities to Azure, simplifying connectivity for enterprise AI workloads and agentic applications.

articles.title: Gartner warns enterprises to rethink AI infrastructure
articles.summary: Gartner expects AI agents to play a growing role in incident triage, change validation, and IT remediation, but warns that uncontrolled token-based pricing could push costs more than 50% above expectations by 2027. The firm recommends prioritizing measurable use cases, strengthening observability, and preparing hybrid infrastructure for AI workloads.

articles.title: Snowflake makes the case for smaller AI models
articles.summary: Snowflake argues that enterprises should prioritize intelligence efficiency over deploying the most powerful AI model for every task. Its approach uses model routing to balance performance, latency, and costs, with internal testing showing up to three times greater token efficiency for certain agent workflows without compromising quality.

articles.title: Google TPUs are coming to Oracle Cloud
articles.summary: Google and Oracle are partnering to bring Google's TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure starting in 2027, giving enterprises more choices for AI training and inference.

articles.title: ServiceNow and OpenAI expand enterprise AI partnership
articles.summary: ServiceNow and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to bring governed ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise security, risk management, and application development.
